# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 1: PER-NODE SELECT ACTIONS
# Clicking a node only stages it as the pending selection; the actual
# unlock (tv_tree_pending_id dispatch) happens via tv_tree_confirm_pending below.

# Conquest Victory Tree
tv_tree_select_conquest_t1 = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	show_message = no
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			has_variable = tv_conquest_victory_enabled
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_tree_conquest_t1_unlocked }
			var:tv_conquest_tree_points ?= { this >= 10 }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			set_variable = { name = tv_tree_pending_id value = 0 }
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

	show_message = no
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			has_variable = tv_diplomatic_victory_enabled
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			has_variable = tv_tree_diplomatic_t1_unlocked
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_tree_diplomatic_b2_1_unlocked }
			var:tv_diplomatic_tree_points ?= { this >= 15 }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			set_variable = { name = tv_tree_pending_id value = 3007 }
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 2: SHARED CONFIRM / CANCEL DISPATCH ACTIONS
# tv_tree_confirm_pending maps the pending id back to the node's unlock effect;
# tv_tree_cancel_pending discards the pending selection untouched.
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

tv_tree_confirm_pending = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	show_message = no
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never

	potential = { always = yes }

	allow = {
		scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_tree_pending_id }
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_tree_pending_id = 0 }
				tv_tree_conquest_t1_unlock_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_tree_pending_id = 1 }
				tv_tree_conquest_t2_unlock_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_tree_pending_id = 2 }
				tv_tree_conquest_t3_unlock_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_tree_pending_id = 3 }
				tv_tree_conquest_t4_unlock_effect = yes

				limit = { var:tv_tree_pending_id = 4 }

				tv_tree_science_b3_2_unlock_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_tree_pending_id = 5012 }
				tv_tree_science_b4_1_unlock_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_tree_pending_id = 5013 }
				tv_tree_science_b4_2_unlock_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_tree_pending_id = 5014 }
				tv_tree_science_b5_1_unlock_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_tree_pending_id = 5015 }
				tv_tree_science_b5_2_unlock_effect = yes
			}
			remove_variable = tv_tree_pending_id
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_tree_cancel_pending = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_religion_generic
	show_message = no
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never

	potential = { always = yes }

	allow = {
		scope:actor = { has_variable = tv_tree_pending_id }
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			remove_variable = tv_tree_pending_id
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}
